note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Old and new phrases, and the article each points to, are supplied; nothing is inferred from the wording and no conclusion is drawn.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The phrase printed in Art. 4 is replaced: 'as set out in Art. 9' becomes 'as set out in Art. 12' (as supplied). The old trail and ring become ghosts; the flag hops on to Art. 12 and a new trail is drawn.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the change sits in the middle of a chain. Art. 4 refers to Art. 9 and Art. 9 printed 'see Art. 12'; the supplied new phrase is 'see Art. 6', which sends the last hop back across the pages to Art. 6 on the first page.
